description: This file is a CMake module script used to find and configure the DBusClient library dependencies, including locating the library and header files, and setting up an imported target for use in the build process.

methods.name: find_package
methods.description: Detects the presence of the specified package using CMake's find_package

methods.name: pkg_check_modules
methods.description: Uses pkg-config to check for the specified modules and set variables accordingly

methods.name: find_library
methods.description: Locates the specified library, considering hint directories

methods.name: find_path
methods.description: Finds the directory containing a specific header file

methods.name: add_library
methods.description: Creates a new library target, here used to create an imported target for DBusClient

methods.name: set_target_properties
methods.description: Sets properties on the target, such as include directories and linked libraries
